changelog: Client-Side Payment Date Validation: Restricts cashier and accountant payment date entry to today or past dates using HTML5 max attribute and real-time form validation.
Form Error Alerts & Reset: Prevents submission if a future payment date is entered and auto-resets the picker to today with a clear user notice.
Data Service Safety Net: Validates and caps payment dates at the data persistence layer to ensure database records maintain complete date integrity.
